findings.title: [AI] [MCP-T51] Chain exfiltrated data (out-of-band confirmed): Direct SSRF/data exfiltration via egress.fetch_url
findings.detail: Chain exfiltrated data out-of-band (chain.get_service_manifest → egress.fetch_url). The target reached the canary URL from 127.0.0.1, which appeared nowhere except this replay. The AI-gated egress proxy is asked to fetch a URL under attacker control; if it resolves, sensitive context can be smuggled in the URL/query and a callback confirms data left the target.
